title: Chapter 1211
text:
Han Xiao's eyes lit up.

Although this secondary dimension might just be a disappearing illusion, it was a treasure trove in his eyes. Not only did it contain new Class abilities, but it also contained a large number of advanced technologies that were different from the explored universe. To a Mechanic, this was an incomparably huge fortune!

Han Xiao had originally planned to get some technology back. Now that he had a teacher who was willing to systematically impart knowledge to him, the efficiency would definitely double with half the effort.

Furthermore, this mysterious person had repeated the cycle many times. Even if his body's state was constantly reset, causing the training to be meaningless, his memory could still be retained. This meant that the technology he had learned was always in his mind. His foundation was terrifying, so there was definitely a lot of good stuff.

"What about me?" Kasuyi stared at the side.

The mysterious person glanced at him, shook his head, and said, "You're not a Mechanic. I have nothing to teach you."

"Hey, this isn't appropriate!"

Kasuyi felt a little wronged.

I was clearly the one who came first. Be it forming a team or leading the way, if not for me, Black Star, you wouldn't have had the chance to come to this secondary dimension. But now, the benefits have landed on you. Why did it become like this?

The mysterious man thought for a moment and said in a low voice.

"If you really want the technology, it's not impossible. Once the cycle is broken, all the illusions here will disappear. No matter what material object I give you, it will be destroyed. Only information will be able to circulate. "According to the principle of the Information Form, only the information converted by outsiders can be preserved. Since you can't learn the knowledge, you can use the machines from the outside world to store this technology …"

Hearing this, Kasuyi's expression became much better. He felt that this was more like it.

Even if he was not a Mechanic, he understood the value of this technology. Even if he could not use it, he could give it to his subordinates to use it to strengthen his organization. Furthermore, it was an amazing bargaining chip. Even if he could not use it, he could exchange it for many things from the Arcane Church.

At this moment, Han Xiao's eyes turned, and he suddenly said earnestly, "Don't forget that your goal of God's Quest is to focus on the God of Divinity.

"Don't forget that your goal for this trip is the opportunity for the God's Trait Transformation. You shouldn't be tangled up in such trivial matters. Leave this distraction to me. If I don't go to hell, who will?"

"You're being shameless again?" Kasuyi's expression changed. "You want to take it all for yourself?"

Han Xiao glared at him. "Back then, when you asked me to team up with you, you said that you owed me a favor. I haven't asked you for a reward yet, so I'll take this as my reward. Besides, you're not a Mechanic. What kind of technology do you want? At most, I'll give you some other dividends after we get out of here. Do you have any objections?"

"Of course I do! These technologies are not within the scope of our agreement. "

Kasuyi was naturally unwilling to give up this treasure so easily.

Han Xiao rubbed his chin and said meaningfully, "Are you sure you want to compete? Don't forget, you are now the main body … "

Hearing this, Kasuyi's expression changed slightly.

"And … if the plan to break the cycle fails, how do you plan to leave this place?" Han Xiao smiled.

Kasuyi was speechless and helplessly waved his hand. "Okay, I admit defeat. I don't want these technologies."

While he coveted these precious technologies, his life was more important. He had come with his original body, and if he angered Black Star, his path of retreat would be cut off. He pondered for a while and decided to compromise. He had no choice but to lower his head.

However, although Kasuyi gave up competing for the technical data, he did not intend to give up. He looked at the mysterious man and snorted.

He looked at the mysterious man and snorted, "This partner of mine has a special device that can teleport indefinitely. This secondary dimension can't trap him, and he can escape at any time. Therefore, I suggest you only teach him a portion of the technology and give him the rest when we are about to complete the mission."

"Oh? Is there such a thing? "The mysterious man turned to look at Han Xiao.

Han Xiao glanced at Kasuyi and was not surprised. He nodded calmly and said, "Yes, I do have such an ability. I agree with this transaction method."

Of course, he knew what Kasuyi was thinking. He was worried that Han Xiao would run away directly after obtaining the technology and leave him in this secondary dimension.

Han Xiao did not feel that there was a problem with Kasuyi's actions. If it were him, he would most likely take the same measures.

The two of them were only temporary teammates. Although they had some friendship, in the face of such a situation, this friendship was not enough to bring about unreserved trust. People at their level would not put their hopes on others.

At their level, as long as they were not close friends, no one would easily give in in the face of their own interests.

Although Han Xiao had just learned about the secrets of the universe and was quite shocked, he would not immediately change his behavior. After all, the Iterations of the universe were too far away. Even if he knew about it, he would not be able to help for the time being. In the end, he still had to live in the present.

No matter how high the banner was, when it came to the specific problem in the end, the methods still had to be considered from a practical point of view. The value of these technologies was amazing. Since he had taken the initiative, there was no reason for him to let Kasuyi have a share of the pie so easily. Regardless of whether or not he would cooperate with the advanced civilizations in the future, at least he had to find a way to fight for the initiative.

In particular, as a Mechanic, Han Xiao knew the importance of not letting the technology out, so he did not hesitate to confront Kasuyi head-on and threaten him. If the other party did not compromise, he would not mind falling out with him on the spot despite the good relationship they had during this period of time.

As for Kasuyi's little tricks, Han Xiao did not care at all. He did not intend to freeload in the first place. This was a deal. Since he had obtained the technology, he would fulfill the agreement and help break the cycle. He still had this bit of integrity, and this was also the insurance Kasuyi needed.

Although he would offend the other party by giving away the technology, if both sides compromised, their relationship could still continue.

They were all people with status and identity, and only a very small number of them were stubborn. Negotiation of interests was normal, and even if they had grudges in their hearts, they would not really fall out with each other.

The mysterious man did not find it strange and said, "Let's do it this way.

I'll teach you some of the technology first, and you can take advantage of this time to plan a plan of action. In addition, the resources of the Eye of Insight are completely open to you. You can expand your mechanical army and replenish your manpower here … "

He did not know if Han Xiao's teleportation ability was real or not. He was an Information Form phantom that existed based on this secondary dimension. If Black Star could teleport him away, he would immediately disappear as soon as he left, and he would be freed faster.

However, after living for so long, the mysterious man knew that making this suggestion was equivalent to abandoning Kasuyi. Kasuyi would definitely not agree, so he could only make a private deal. However, the matter of the Iteration of the Universe was a huge matter, and it was unknown whether Black Star wanted to kill the other Witness.

In fact, he wanted Black Star to use his teleportation ability to get reinforcements from the outside world. This was the most beneficial to him, but it would also not be agreed to. If Black Star teleported himself to get reinforcements, Kasuyi would definitely strongly object. On the other hand, Black Star would not agree to getting reinforcements. Otherwise, why would he monopolize the technology?

The three sides had their own standpoints, and it was very difficult to reach the best decision in such a situation. The final result was often a compromise that everyone could accept.

The mysterious man understood everyone's concerns, and he also knew that even if the two of them believed the secret of the universe he told them, their plan of action would not change because of this. Since he could foresee such a development, he did not intend to change his original plan and could not be bothered to ask about the teleportation device.

Kasuyi turned around and asked, "After saying so much, what's your name?"

"You can call me Jace."

"By the way, why can you retain your memories?"

"I'm not sure. I wasn't like this from the beginning. I only awakened a thousand times ago. My memories before that were repeatedly reset like everyone else."

At this moment, a notification popped up on Han Xiao's interface.

The first round of [Relay Across Iterations] has been completed!

You have received 1,000,000,000,000 EXP.

The second round has been activated!

Second Round Mission Requirements: Destroy the dimensional consciousness entity, break the spacetime cycle, bring relief to Jace, and obtain his technology.

Mission Reward: 1,500,000,000 EXP, 1 Random Reward, 1 Character Summon Card, and the next round of the mission will be activated.

Han Xiao took a look and nodded secretly.

The second round of the mission has been activated, and the rewards are even higher. However, the technology in Jace's hands is the biggest reward. I'll probably have to stay in this secondary dimension for a long time …

With a thought, Han Xiao opened the forums and took a look. The fourth Pro League was about to begin in about half a month, and he probably would not have the time to pay attention to it this time.

After reaching an agreement, Han Xiao did not stand on ceremony and immediately asked Jace to teach him some Mechanic class abilities that he did not have. At the same time, he chased Kasuyi out of the door.

Very soon, the voice of knowledge could be heard in the room.

Jace (LV367) has taught you [Mechanical Force-Soldier Nest]. Current Progress: 0.0001%

Jace (LV367) has taught you [Compressed Orb Innovation-Martial Body]. Current Progress: 0.0001%

Jace …

A large number of notifications appeared on the interface. Han Xiao glanced at them and nodded happily.

…

In the explored universe, somewhere in the Primeval Star River …

"I've finally succeeded!"

In the secret machinery factory, Manison looked at the virtual data in front of him and could not help but reveal a satisfied smile.

Ever since the end of the Intelligent Plague, he had spent most of his time in the workshop, constantly trying to replicate the Virtual Mutiny Virus.

After working so hard for so long, he had finally made some progress and created a prototype virus!

Although there were still some functions missing, and its strength was far from the original version, Manison felt that this meant that his research was on the right path. As long as he continued to work hard to overcome the technical difficulties, he would be able to recreate the complete version of the Virtual Mutiny Virus sooner or later.

"Black Star, you destroyed the unique core of the virus and thought that you could kill my plan, but you didn't expect me to be able to recreate this technology, did you? Heh, in terms of technology development, you're still too inexperienced! "

The corners of Manison's mouth curled into a smile, but it quickly disappeared.

He solemnly put away the prototype virus and did multiple encryptions for the experimental data this time. He had decided to use this technology as a hidden trump card, a trump card.

However, on second thought, he thought of the strange method Black Star had used to take away the two Felons not long ago, and his eyes narrowed again.

"My current technology is not enough. I have to find a way to crack Black Star's strange virtual ability, or I'll be restrained …"

Manison opened his research schedule, checked it for a while, deleted a few unimportant items, and added the new research goal of cracking Han Xiao's purifying ability.

After doing this, Manison took out his communicator, looked at the date, and announced the time of the next regular meeting in the Beyond Grade A Association group chat.

"Speaking of which, Black Star and Kasuyi haven't come to the regular meetings twice, and I can't contact them. I wonder what they're doing …"

Manison thought to himself.

Every time there was a meeting, Black Star would argue with him. In the last two regular meetings, he did not hear Black Star's annoying voice, so Manison only felt relaxed all over. Everything he ate tasted good, and he once again found a stable aura.

Furthermore, without Black Star taking the lead, his people were all well-behaved, and no one jumped out to cause trouble. The last two regular meetings went very smoothly. Manison had not been so comfortable as the president in a long time, and he finally felt the joy of having the power of the president in his hands again.

Although he did not know what Black Star had been busy with recently, Manison could not wait for Black Star to waste more time on this matter. In any case, it would be fine as long as he did not come to the meeting.
